overview.title: Building a Brighter Future Through Learning
paragraphs: Bright Future Academy is a fictional school created for testing and demonstrating an education website template.
The academy's sample educational approach focuses on curiosity, confidence, academic understanding and practical skills.
This demonstration highlights how an institution can present its learning programs, mission, vision, team and contact information through one JSON configuration.

items.question: Is Bright Future Academy a real school?
items.answer: No. Bright Future Academy is a fictional demonstration institution created for testing an educational website template.

items.question: How can I enquire about admissions?
items.answer: You can explore the demo enquiry form. Actual admissions are not offered through this demonstration website.

items.question: Can I visit the academy?
items.answer: No physical campus exists. The displayed location is fictional and used only for testing.

items.question: Does the enquiry form send my message automatically?
items.answer: No. The form is configured for mailto, which requires an email application and manual sending. The demo recipient is not configured for real enquiries.
